falcastrum , i, n. id.,
I.an agricultural instrument, a bush-hook: “a similitudine falcis vocatum. Est autem ferramentum curvum cum manubrio longo ad densitatem veprium succidendam,” Isid. Orig. 20, 14, 5 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
